instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp thyme, dried
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is done, add flour to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until onion is well coated, about 1 minute.

Add broccoli, broth, and milk to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender and soup is thickened slightly, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
3 cups whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Once thickened, transfer 2 cups of soup to the reserved bowl. Using a hand blender, purée remaining soup in the pot until smooth. Return unblended soup to the pot. (If you prefer an evenly smooth soup, skip removing a portion of soup and purée it all.)
Return soup to medium heat, add cheese, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, top with additional cheese, and enjoy!
